name: gphone
description: An open-source TypeScript phone for FiveM

scripts.build: pnpm clearbuild && pnpm typecheck && node scripts/generate-manifests.js && node build/build-bundle.js && pnpm build:web
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter web install && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter web check
scripts.watch: pnpm clearbuild && node scripts/generate-manifests.js && cross-env IS_WATCH_MODE=1 node build/build-bundle.js

author: mbiddle
